test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A descriptive adjective is needed here to clarify which QR codes are being referred to in the sentence.
 
• The word 'subsequent' means following in time or order.
 
• Given the first QR code has already been mentioned, 'subsequent' fits well in the context, meaning the QR codes that follow the first one.
 
• The action described (accessing relevant e-resources), logically would pertain to QR codes after the initial one which is used for accessing the e-textbook, thus 'subsequent' is an apt choice.

*Therefore the correct passage is: The coded box placed on the first page of every chapter is called quick response code. The first QR code is to access the complete e-textbook. The **subsequent** QR codes will help you access the relevant e-resources linked to each other. This will help you(4)_________ your learning in a (5)__________ manner.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Irrelevant': This term implies that something is not related or not relevant to the subject matter or context. Considering the sentence discusses QR codes that help access relevant e-resources, the QR codes would not be 'irrelevant'.
 
• 'Former': This term generally refers to the first of two things or persons mentioned (or the earlier one in time). Since the first QR code has already been discussed, 'former' is not suitable here.
 
• 'Shown': This term doesn't provide any clear chronological or categorical differentiation of the QR codes that would be necessary given the context.
